name: [UPD🎃] BRASS HELL [INCREMENTAL]
desc:
Welcome to BRASS HELL.

Clock in at a remote ammunition factory buried in a blizzard. Pack rounds, fill crates, and earn your next upgrade. The orders never stop.

⚙️ Work the press through hands-on crafting
📦 Deliver shipments and upgrade your workshop
🔓 Unlock new rounds as you build
👥 Share the factory with up to 4 players
📄 Find scattered documents and uncover what happened here

Stay warm. Keep working. Don’t ask where the shipments go.

🔧 Early release — more updates coming.


Credit: @wxyz1v (Thumbnail Artist)
